spawn_occupied.rule: The live checkSolid(spawn, false) result; the frame records no spawn_occupied yet, so the driver defaults false ("spawn free") until a collision slice lands.

spawn_visual_occupied.rule: The live checkSolid(spawn, true) result; the frame records no spawn_visual_occupied yet, so the driver defaults false until a collision slice lands.

in_position_count.rule: Drones in position (AssemblerAI.inPosition()); the frame records no drones_in_position yet, so the driver defaults 0 -- eff 0 and no progress until a drone-position slice lands.

allow_update.rule: BuildingComp.allowUpdate() (BuildingComp.java:622-627, team/environment/map-area gate); the frame records no allow_update yet, so the driver defaults true.

can_create.rule: Units.canCreate(team, plan.unit); the live evaluation needs C07, so the driver keeps reading frame["can_create"], default true (already read by the N2132 shouldConsume branch).

power_status.rule: The power status: null means no power consumer -> 1.0 (Java power == null ? 1f : power.status); the driver folds !enabled into 0.0 before passing it.

unit_build_speed.rule: Rules.unitBuildSpeed(team) (Rules.java:271-272): the global unitBuildSpeedMultiplier (default 1f) times the team multiplier (default 1f).

source_delta.rule: The tick delta for lerpDelta (SourceMathState.source_lerp_delta, Mathf.lerpDelta = lerp(from, to, clamp(progress * Time.delta))).

source_unit_assembler_production_tick_st.rule: Source-backed UnitAssembler live production tick from UnitAssemblerBuild.updateTile().

progress.rule: The frame progress after the tick: advanced by edelta * unit_build_speed * eff / plan.time while producing, reset to 0.0 on completion (spawned() sets progress = 0f) and on tier change, unchanged when occupied, efficiency 0, or can_create false.

warmup.rule: The frame warmup after the tick: lerped toward efficiency while producing, toward 0.0 otherwise (0.1 per tick).

drone_progress.java_expr: if(units.size < dronesCreated && enabled && (droneProgress += delta() * state.rules.unitBuildSpeed(team) * powerStatus / droneConstructTime) >= 1f){
drone_progress.rule: The drone progress after the tick: advanced by source_delta * unit_build_speed * power_status / drone_construct_time while a drone slot is free, reset to 0.0 on spawn and when all slots are filled.

total_drone_progress.rule: The total drone progress after the tick: advanced by the new drone_warmup * source_delta every tick.

completed.rule: True when progress reached 1.0 this tick: spawned() fired (consume() + blocks.clear() + UnitCreateEvent) and the tick driver performs the N2128 consume call.

was_occupied.rule: The spawn occupancy after the tick: the spawn_occupied input (live checkSolid(spawn, false)); the production gate reads the new value.

source_unit_assembler_production_tick_st.rule: Source-backed UnitAssembler live production tick from UnitAssemblerBuild.updateTile().

tile_x.rule: The x of the bridge being ticked (ItemBridge.java:150, the positionsValid call in linkValid): one end of the row/column check.

tile_y.rule: The y of the bridge being ticked (ItemBridge.java:150, the positionsValid call in linkValid): one end of the row/column check.

other_x.rule: The x of the partner tile (ItemBridge.java:150, the positionsValid call in linkValid): the other end of the row/column check, unpacked from the frame link.

other_y.rule: The y of the partner tile (ItemBridge.java:150, the positionsValid call in linkValid): the other end of the row/column check, unpacked from the frame link.

range.rule: The bridge range (ItemBridge.java:159/161): the positionsValid bound. The driver reads the catalog block.properties["range"] (12 for phase-conveyor, Blocks.java:2118); the Java field default is 0 when the def does not set it (`public int range;`, ItemBridge.java:27).

blocks_match.java_expr: return ((other.block() == tile.block() && tile.block() == this) || (!(tile.block() instanceof ItemBridge) && other.block() == this))
blocks_match.rule: Whether the other tile block matches (ItemBridge.java:152): the driver ticks ItemBridge builds only, so tile.block() is always this and the clause reduces to the other block being an ItemBridge, gathered by the driver from the partner sprite.

teams_match.rule: Whether the teams match (ItemBridge.java:153): with tile.block() always this, the clause reduces to other.team() == tile.team(); the driver reads the partner team the same way as this sprite team (SOURCE_BUILD_TEAM_META_KEY, default derelict).

other_link.rule: The partner build link (ItemBridge.java:154): the checkDouble comparison value, read from the partner frame; -1 when the partner frame is not bound yet.

this_pos.rule: This tile packed position (ItemBridge.java:154, tile.pos()): the checkDouble comparison target, packed with arc Point2.pack.

other_exists.java_expr: if(other == null || tile == null || !positionsValid(tile.x, tile.y, other.x, other.y)) return false;
other_exists.rule: Whether the other tile exists (ItemBridge.java:150): a null other tile is never valid; the driver sets this false when no sprite sits at the unpacked link cell.

check_double.rule: Whether to run the double-link check (ItemBridge.java:154): updateTile calls the two-arg linkValid, which passes true (ItemBridge.java:145-146, `return linkValid(tile, other, true);`); checkIncoming passes false (ItemBridge.java:310), which waits for its own slice.

source_item_bridge_link_input.rule: Source-backed ItemBridge link frame state from ItemBridge.java / BuildingComp.java / arc Point2.java.

link.java_expr: config(Point2.class, (ItemBridgeBuild tile, Point2 i) -> tile.link = Point2.pack(i.x + tile.tileX(), i.y + tile.tileY()));
link.rule: The packed link position on the frame (ItemBridge.java:64, the Point2 config handler; :66, the Integer handler; default -1, :198). progress.rule: The advanced progress (BurstDrill.java:99): progress += delta() * speed in the gate branch, unchanged in the blocked branch, modulo drillTime after an offload (BurstDrill.java:112, `progress %= drillTime;`).

warmup.rule: The advanced warmup (BurstDrill.java:92): approachDelta toward progress/drillTime at 0.01f in the gate branch, toward 0f at 0.01f when blocked (BurstDrill.java:101).

time_drilled.rule: The advanced timeDrilled (BurstDrill.java:96): timeDrilled += pow2In(progress/drillTime) * speed, with NO delta factor -- Java adds the curve value times speed per tick, not per second. pow2In(a) = a * a (Interp.java:29, PowIn.apply :119-121).

last_drill_speed.rule: The advanced lastDrillSpeed (BurstDrill.java:98): 1/drillTime * speed * dominantItems in the gate branch, 0f when blocked (BurstDrill.java:102).

smooth_progress.rule: The advanced smoothProgress (BurstDrill.java:89): lerpDelta toward progress/(drillTime - 20f) at 0.1f, computed BEFORE the gate branch from the pre-advance progress, so it moves even when blocked.

invert_time.rule: The advanced invertTime (BurstDrill.java:111): set to 1f on offload; otherwise it decays by delta()/invertedTime while positive (BurstDrill.java:81, invertedTime 200f, BurstDrill.java:26), with no clamp at 0, exactly like Java.

items.rule: The next items map (BurstDrill.java:107-109): the offload branch adds dominantItems of the dominant item through the shared inventory helper, the no-neighbor fallback branch of offload (BuildingComp.java:1017, `handleItem(self(), item);`); unchanged when no offload fires.

offloaded.rule: The offloaded count this tick (BurstDrill.java:107-109): dominantItems when the offload branch fires, 0 otherwise.

drill_time.rule: The effective drillTime (BurstDrill.java:87 + :54): the BurstDrill getDrillTime OVERRIDE, drillTime / drillMultipliers.get(item, 1f), with NO hardness term -- NOT the base-Drill formula (Drill.java:171). 0.0 when the dominant item is null (Java returns before computing it, BurstDrill.java:77-79).

speed.java_expr: float speed = Mathf.lerp(1f, liquidBoostIntensity, optionalEfficiency) * efficiency;
speed.rule: The speed this tick (BurstDrill.java:94): lerp(1, liquidBoostIntensity, optionalEfficiency) * efficiency in the gate branch, 0.0 when blocked or the dominant item is null.

pump_time.rule: The advanced pump time (SolidPump.java:138): pumpTime += the NEW warmup * efficiency * Time.delta * timeScale; drives the rotator spin (SolidPump.java:112).

The driver gathers it per tick from the N2087 proximity helper (source_pump_proximity_state) return value, already called for the N2205 gate; the family frame carries no liquid_drop key.

amount.rule: The proximity amount (Pump.java:113, summed liquidMultiplier over the linked tiles passing canPump, Pump.java:141-152). The driver gathers it per tick from the same N2087 proximity helper return value as liquid_drop; it scales maxPump linearly (Pump.java:162).

liquids.rule: The Building.liquids LiquidModule (the sprite liquids meta, initialized at placement via source_initialize_building_liquids_state), read through the shared liquid module source_get_state by liquid id to find the current stored amount for the maxPump cap. The pure advance does NOT mutate it: the driver performs liquids.add through source_add_state after the call (LiquidModule.java:84-91, `liquids[liquid.id] += amount; current = liquid;`).

liquid_capacity.rule: The block def capacity (rotary-pump 80f, Blocks.java:2308; impulse-pump 200f, Blocks.java:2317), passed by the driver -- the catalog carries no liquidCapacity for pump defs, so the driver resolves it from the block id (the N2190/N2199 def constant precedent); unknown Pump defs fall back to the Block.java:77 default (`liquidCapacity = -1f;`). The frame does not carry it.

pump_amount.rule: The block def pump amount (rotary-pump 0.2f, the class default, Pump.java:20, Blocks.java:2306; impulse-pump 0.22f, Blocks.java:2315), passed by the driver -- the catalog carries no pumpAmount for pump defs, so the driver resolves it from the block id (the same def constant precedent as liquidCapacity); unknown Pump defs fall back to the class default 0.2f.

source_delta.rule: Time.delta in ticks (seconds * 60 through game_source_delta, arc Time.java:26, `Math.min(Core.graphics.getDeltaTime() * 60f, 3f)`), never raw seconds (the N2186/N2187/N2191 lesson). The raw delta drives totalProgress (Pump.java:176) and the warmup approachDelta step (Mathf.java:420-422, approachDelta = approach(from, to, Time.delta * speed)); the scaled delta() = Time.delta * timeScale (BuildingComp.java:1922-1924) drives maxPump and consTimer.

time_scale.rule: The building timeScale (BuildingComp.java:98, `private transient float timeScale = 1f, timeScaleDuration;`), read live from the sprite meta by the driver (SourcePlacedBlockState.time_scale, default 1.0). delta() = Time.delta * timeScale (BuildingComp.java:1922-1924), so timeScale scales maxPump (via edelta) and consTimer, but NOT warmup or totalProgress, which use raw Time.delta.

liquid_id_by_name.rule: The catalog liquid name -> id map (source_liquid_catalog_state), passed by the driver: the module store is id-indexed while liquidDrop is a name, so the pure advance resolves the drop name to the module index through this map (the factory precedent, source_factory_should_consume_state; the same map the N2205 gate takes).

source_mechanical_pump_update_tile_advan.rule: Source-backed Pump updateTile advance from Pump.java / BuildingComp.java / Blocks.java / Block.java.

max_pump.java_expr: float maxPump = Math.min(liquidCapacity - liquids.get(liquidDrop), amount * pumpAmount * edelta());
max_pump.rule: The amount pumped this tick (Pump.java:162): min(remaining capacity, amount * pumpAmount * edelta()), where edelta() = efficiency * Time.delta * timeScale (BuildingComp.java:1922-1929). 0.0 when the pumping branch does not run (efficiency <= 0 or no liquid drop). The driver adds exactly this amount to the store through source_add_state.

liquid_amount.rule: The stored amount of the drop after this tick (Pump.java:163, `liquids.add(liquidDrop, maxPump);`): the pre-tick amount plus max_pump, or the pre-tick amount when the pumping branch does not run. The pure advance computes it without mutating the store; the driver performs the add.

cons_timer.rule: The item-consume timer after this tick (Pump.java:166-169): advanced by delta() = Time.delta * timeScale in the pumping branch, wrapping via `consTimer %= 1f;` (Pump.java:168) when it reaches consumeTime (60f * 5f = 300f, Pump.java:22). consume() is a no-op for these pumps (Pump.java:165, "does nothing for most pumps" -- neither def consumes items, Blocks.java:2304-2320), so the wrap has no item effect. Unchanged when the pumping branch does not run.

warmup.rule: The warmup after this tick (Pump.java:171/173): approachDelta toward 1 when it pumped (maxPump > 0.001f) and toward 0 otherwise, at warmupSpeed 0.019f (Pump.java:23), with the step scaled by raw Time.delta (Mathf.java:420-422), not edelta.

total_progress.rule: The total progress after this tick (Pump.java:176): advanced by the NEW warmup (after the approachDelta step) times raw Time.delta -- no timeScale, no efficiency. It advances even when the pumping branch does not run, as long as warmup has not decayed to 0.

progress.rule: The advanced progress (Separator.java:134/141): + 1/craftTime * edelta() while efficiency > 0, wrapped with progress %= 1f at craft completion.

total_progress.rule: The advanced total progress (Separator.java:131): + warmup * delta() every tick, before the efficiency branch.

seed.rule: The advanced seed (Separator.java:145): incremented once per craft completion (the seed++ of the weighted pick); a fresh frame is seeded from Point2.pack(tile) like created() (Separator.java:82-84), a direct pure call defaults to 0.

items.rule: The items after the craft (Separator.java:158-162): the cons stacks removed by consume() (ConsumeItems.java:44-48) and the picked item added by the offload fallback when the held count fits itemCapacity; unchanged when no craft completes.

cdump.rule: The dump cursor after the offload (BuildingComp.java:1003): advanced by offload_item_state when routing; unchanged with the empty routing context (no neighbors to rotate through).

picked_item.rule: The item the weighted pick drew (Separator.java:150-155): the stack whose [count, count + amount) window holds the randomSeed index; empty when no craft completes or the results are empty.

crafted.rule: Whether a craft completed this tick (Separator.java:140): progress reached 1f, so the branch ran (wrap + pick + consume + conditional offload).

time_scale.rule: The live timeScale read from the sprite meta (SourcePlacedBlockState.time_scale), default 1.0 (BuildingComp.java:98): delta() = Time.delta * timeScale (BuildingComp.java:1922-1924) and lastEfficiency = eff * timeScale * efficiency (WallCrafter.java:211).

drill_time.rule: The def drillTime from the catalog (block.properties["drillTime"], 110f for the cliff-crusher / 48f for the large-cliff-crusher, Blocks.java:3006/:3020; class default 150f, WallCrafter.java:33): the time threshold for the offload + reset (WallCrafter.java:213-215).

output_item.rule: The output item from the catalog (block.properties["output"], "sand" for both defs -- the Java field default, WallCrafter.java:43, set explicitly by both defs, Blocks.java:3009/:3023): the item the offload produces (WallCrafter.java:214).

item_capacity.rule: The item capacity from the catalog (block.properties["itemCapacity"], 10 for the cliff-crusher -- the Java field default, Block.java:75 -- and 20 for the large-cliff-crusher, Blocks.java:3031): the cons gate reads the output count against it (WallCrafter.java:227).

source_wall_crafter_update_tile_advance_.rule: Source-backed WallCrafter updateTile advance from WallCrafter.java / BuildingComp.java / Blocks.java / Block.java.

warmup.rule: The advanced warmup (WallCrafter.java:193): approachDelta toward num(efficiency > 0) at 1f/40f per tick -- 1.0 when powered, 0.0 when not.

eff.java_expr: float eff = getEfficiency(tile.x, tile.y, rotation, dest -> {
eff.rule: The efficiency factor (WallCrafter.java:196-205): the frame efficiency_factor (the live getEfficiency scan stand-in) * lerp(1, 1.6, hasLiquidBooster ? optionalEfficiency : 0) * (itemValid ? 1.6 : 1), with the class boost intensities 1.6f (WallCrafter.java:35/:47).

last_efficiency.rule: The last efficiency (WallCrafter.java:211): eff * timeScale * efficiency -- the drillspeed bar value (WallCrafter.java:71-72).

time.rule: The advanced drill time (WallCrafter.java:213-215): time += edelta() * eff only when cons (Java short-circuits on the gate), with the offload + time %= drillTime reset at the threshold.

total_time.rule: The advanced total time (WallCrafter.java:218): totalTime += edelta() * warmup * (eff <= 0 ? 0 : 1) using the already-updated warmup; no cons guard, so it advances even with a full store.

offloaded.rule: Whether this tick offloaded the output (WallCrafter.java:213-214): true exactly when cons held and time reached drillTime.

items.rule: The items after this tick (BuildingComp.java:1014/:860-861): the offload fallback adds 1 output to the own inventory when the tick offloaded, else unchanged; the neighbor routing (BuildingComp.java:1001-1013) defers.

source_wall_crafter_update_tile_advance_.rule: Source-backed WallCrafter updateTile advance from WallCrafter.java / BuildingComp.java / Blocks.java / Block.java.

frame.rule: The building frame carrying the folded efficiency (stamped by apply_update_consumption_state), the current accumulator / warmup / pump_time / valid_tiles / boost / attribute_env, the live liquids module and the items dict; missing keys default to 0 / {}.

source_delta.rule: Time.delta in ticks (seconds * 60 through game_source_delta, arc Time.java:26): the delta the Arc lerpDelta formula scales by (Mathf.java:430-432) and the base of delta() = Time.delta * timeScale (BuildingComp.java:1922-1924).

time_scale.rule: The live timeScale read from the sprite meta (SourcePlacedBlockState.time_scale), default 1.0 (BuildingComp.java:98): delta() = Time.delta * timeScale (BuildingComp.java:1922-1924).

result_liquid_id.rule: The result liquid's catalog id, resolved by the driver from liquid_id_by_name["oil"] (the def constant oil, Blocks.java:2966 -- the class default is water, SolidPump.java:22); -1 when the catalog has no such liquid, in which case the reused super advance reads typeLiquid as 0.0 and adds nothing.

liquid_capacity.rule: The liquid capacity def constant 40f (Blocks.java:2971) -- the catalog carries no liquidCapacity property for pump defs (the N2190 fogRadius / N2199 transportTime def-constant precedent); the class default is -1f (Block.java:77) but every pump def sets it explicitly.

pump_amount.rule: The pump amount def constant 0.25f (Blocks.java:2969), overriding the Pump class default 0.2f (Pump.java:20); passed through to the reused N2220 SolidPump pure function for super.updateTile() (Fracker.java:37).

item_use_time.rule: The item use time def constant 60f (Blocks.java:2974), overriding the Fracker class default 100f (Fracker.java:8): the accumulator threshold at which updateTile consumes one sand (Fracker.java:32-35).

source_fracker_update_tile_advance_state.rule: Source-backed Fracker updateTile advance from Fracker.java / SolidPump.java / Pump.java / BuildingComp.java / Blocks.java / Block.java / ConsumeItems.java / Consume.java / ItemModule.java.

accumulator.rule: The advanced accumulator (Fracker.java:32-38): one itemUseTime subtracted when the threshold is reached (after consume()), then delta() * efficiency added; frozen when efficiency is 0 (the else branch never touches it).

warmup.rule: The advanced warmup: the reused super advance lerps it toward 1f while pumping (SolidPump.java:130) and toward 0f while idle (SolidPump.java:134); the Fracker else branch decays it itself at the same 0.02f rate (Fracker.java:41) without calling super.updateTile(). Scales by raw Time.delta, never by timeScale.

pump_time.rule: The advanced pump time (SolidPump.java:138, via super.updateTile()): pumpTime += the NEW warmup * efficiency * Time.delta * timeScale; FROZEN when efficiency is 0, because the Fracker else branch never calls super.updateTile() (Fracker.java:40-43).

last_pump.rule: The last pump rate: maxPump over raw Time.delta while pumping (SolidPump.java:129, via super.updateTile()), 0f while idle (SolidPump.java:135) and 0f in the Fracker else branch (Fracker.java:42).

max_pump.java_expr: float maxPump = Math.min(liquidCapacity - typeLiquid(), pumpAmount * delta() * fraction * efficiency);
max_pump.rule: The amount pumped this tick (SolidPump.java:127, via super.updateTile()): min(capacity headroom, pumpAmount * delta() * fraction * efficiency), added to the store by the reused N2220 function (SolidPump.java:128); 0.0 when efficiency is 0 (super never runs).

fraction.java_expr: float fraction = Math.max(validTiles + boost + (attribute == null ? 0 : attribute.env()), 0);
fraction.rule: The pump fraction (SolidPump.java:124, via super.updateTile()): max(validTiles + boost + attribute.env(), 0) from the explicit frame inputs; the live onProximityUpdate fill (SolidPump.java:150-159) waits for its own slice (covered by the existing Fracker fraction entry); 0.0 when efficiency is 0 (super never runs).

items.rule: The items dict after consume() (ConsumeItems.java:44-48): one sand removed when the accumulator reaches itemUseTime, clamped to the held count like ItemModule.remove (ItemModule.java:258-263); unchanged when the threshold is not reached or efficiency is 0. No live intake fills the dict yet (new deferral).

source_fracker_update_tile_advance_state.rule: Source-backed Fracker updateTile advance from Fracker.java / SolidPump.java / Pump.java / BuildingComp.java / Blocks.java / Block.java / ConsumeItems.java / Consume.java / ItemModule.java.

frame.rule: The building frame carrying the folded efficiency (stamped by apply_update_consumption_state) and the current transport_counter / warmup / time / time_speed / moved / was_moved / incoming / items / take_rotation; missing keys default to the Java field defaults (time -8f, the rest 0 / false / {} / []).

source_delta.rule: Time.delta in ticks (seconds * 60 through game_source_delta, arc Time.java:26): the delta the Arc approachDelta formula scales by (Mathf.java:420-422) and the base of delta() = Time.delta * timeScale (BuildingComp.java:1922-1924).

time_scale.rule: The live timeScale read from the sprite meta (SourcePlacedBlockState.time_scale), default 1.0 (BuildingComp.java:98): delta() = Time.delta * timeScale (BuildingComp.java:1922-1924); approachDelta does NOT scale by it.

transport_time.rule: The transport time def constant 2f (Blocks.java:2119) -- the catalog carries no transportTime property for the phase-conveyor (the N2190 fogRadius / N2199 def-constant precedent); the class field is unset (ItemBridge.java:28).

item_capacity.rule: The item capacity def constant 10 (ItemBridge.java:49, also the Block class default, Block.java:75) -- the acceptItem gate on the partner (ItemBridge.java:425).

had_valid_link.rule: The freshly recomputed link validity from the N2197 driver (ItemBridge.java:332-333): the advance branches on it (doDump + warmup = 0f when false, registration + warmup + updateTransport when true) but does NOT recompute it.

tile_pos.rule: This tile packed position (ItemBridge.java:340): the value registered on the partner incoming list (ItemBridge.java:341-343).

partner.rule: The partner snapshot gathered by the driver (exists / pos / items / incoming): the other ItemBridgeBuild whose frame receives the incoming registration (ItemBridge.java:339-344) and the handleItem handoff (ItemBridge.java:359-360).

incoming_valid.rule: The per-incoming-entry validity gathered by the driver (pos -> bool): linkValid(tile, other, false) AND the other build links back at this tile (ItemBridge.java:310); a missing entry reads false, so an entry whose tile is gone prunes.

item_order.rule: The item names in content-id order (the catalog item_names_by_id): the order ItemModule.take() rotates over (ItemModule.java:191-204), starting at the frame take_rotation.

source_item_bridge_update_transport_stat.rule: Source-backed ItemBridge updateTile transport advance from ItemBridge.java / BuildingComp.java / Blocks.java / ItemModule.java / Block.java.

transport_counter.rule: The advanced transport counter (ItemBridge.java:356/366): charged by edelta() = efficiency * Time.delta * timeScale, spent by transportTime per handoff attempt (even when the take is null or the partner rejects -- the decrement is unconditional inside the while loop).

warmup.rule: The advanced warmup (ItemBridge.java:345/337): approachDelta toward the folded efficiency at 1/30f when linked, 0f when unlinked; approachDelta scales by raw Time.delta.

time.rule: The advanced animation time (ItemBridge.java:328): time += the NEW timeSpeed * delta(), starting from -8f (ItemBridge.java:201).

time_speed.rule: The advanced time speed (ItemBridge.java:326): approachDelta toward (wasMoved ? 1 : 0) at 1/60f, scaling by raw Time.delta; wasMoved is the frame input (the timer snapshot defers).

moved.rule: Whether an item moved this tick (ItemBridge.java:361): set on a successful handoff, never cleared here (the timer reset defers).

incoming.rule: The pruned incoming list (ItemBridge.java:305-317): entries whose partner no longer links back at this tile are removed, in order.

items.rule: The self items after the transport loop (ItemBridge.java:358-364): taken items leave, rejected items come back via items.add(item, 1) (undoFlow is a port no-op -- flow cacheSums only, ItemModule.java:252-256).

take_rotation.rule: The advanced take rotation (ItemModule.java:198): the index after the last taken item in content-id order, so successive takes round-robin over present item types.

partner_items.rule: The partner items after the handoff (ItemBridge.java:360; handleItem adds 1, BuildingComp.java:860-862): one entry per accepted item, capped by the capacity gate.

partner_incoming.rule: The partner incoming after registration (ItemBridge.java:339-344): this tile position added when linked and not already present.

source_item_bridge_update_transport_stat.rule: Source-backed ItemBridge updateTile transport advance from ItemBridge.java / BuildingComp.java / Blocks.java / ItemModule.java / Block.java.

frame.rule: The building frame carrying the folded efficiency (stamped by apply_update_consumption_state), the current target / offset / strength / rotation, and the deferred-fill target inputs; Java field defaults target null (RepairTurret.java:154), strength 0.0, rotation 90 (RepairTurret.java:156), efficiency 0.0 (BuildingComp.java:85).

source_delta.rule: Time.delta in ticks (seconds * 60 through game_source_delta, arc Time.java:26): the delta the Arc lerpDelta/slerpDelta formulas scale by (Mathf.java:430-432/:460-462) and edelta() multiplies (BuildingComp.java:1927-1929).

time_scale.rule: The live timeScale read from the sprite meta (SourcePlacedBlockState.time_scale), default 1.0 (BuildingComp.java:98): delta() = Time.delta * timeScale (BuildingComp.java:1922-1924) and the rotation slerp progress is 0.5f * efficiency * timeScale (RepairTurret.java:209).

repair_speed.rule: The def repairSpeed from the driver constants (0.45f for the repair-point, 3f for the repair-turret, Blocks.java:6388/:6400; class default 0.3f, RepairTurret.java:33): the heal amount factor (RepairTurret.java:207).

repair_radius.rule: The def repairRadius from the driver constants (60f for the repair-point, 145f for the repair-turret, Blocks.java:6389/:6401; class default 50f, RepairTurret.java:32): the clear range (RepairTurret.java:193) and the re-acquire range (RepairTurret.java:216).

building_x.rule: The building world x: Building x is tile.drawx() (BuildingComp.java:124), drawx is block.offset + tile.worldx() (Tile.java:175-176) with offset ((size + 1) % 2) * tilesize / 2f (Block.java:761); the angle origin (RepairTurret.java:204) and the re-acquire center (RepairTurret.java:216).

building_y.rule: The building world y: Building y is tile.drawy() (BuildingComp.java:124), drawy is block.offset + tile.worldy() (Tile.java:179-180); the angle origin (RepairTurret.java:204) and the re-acquire center (RepairTurret.java:216).

candidates.java_expr: target = Units.closest(team, x, y, repairRadius, Unit::damaged);
candidates.rule: The explicit re-acquire candidate list (each a target dict with x / y / hit_size / damaged / valid): the stand-in for the Units.closest query (Units.java:358-372). Empty means the timer did not fire (the driver always passes an empty list -- no live unit query); non-empty models a timer tick and overwrites the frame target exactly like Java's unconditional assignment (RepairTurret.java:216).

source_repair_turret_update_tile_advance.rule: Source-backed RepairTurret updateTile advance from RepairTurret.java / BuildingComp.java / Units.java / HealthComp.java / Block.java / Tile.java / Blocks.java / Mathf.java / Angles.java / Position.java.

target.java_expr: if(target != null && (target.dead() || target.dst(this) - target.hitSize/2f > repairRadius || target.health() >= target.maxHealth())){
target.rule: The target after one tick (RepairTurret.java:193-195 + 214-217): null when cleared (dead / edge distance beyond repairRadius / full health) or when a re-acquire tick found no qualifying candidate; otherwise the kept target or the re-acquired closest damaged valid in-range candidate.

offset.rule: The offset after one tick (RepairTurret.java:197-199): zeroed when the target is null, unchanged otherwise (its non-zero values come from drawBeam, RepairTurret.java:106-150, not from updateTile). Stored as {"x", "y"}.

strength.rule: The strength after one tick (RepairTurret.java:212): lerpDelta toward 1f when healing, toward 0f otherwise, at 0.08f * Time.delta -- and lerpDelta multiplies by Time.delta again (Mathf.java:430-432), so the effective progress is 0.08 * Time.delta^2.

rotation.rule: The rotation after one tick (RepairTurret.java:209): slerpDelta toward the target angle at 0.5f * efficiency * timeScale -- the wrapped angle lerp (Mathf.java:455-462); unchanged when the target is null or efficiency is 0 (the branch gate, RepairTurret.java:203).

heal_amount.rule: The heal amount for this tick as a pure result (RepairTurret.java:207): repairSpeed * strength * edelta() * multiplier with multiplier 1.0 (the coolant branch, RepairTurret.java:189-191, waits for the coolant row) and edelta() = efficiency * Time.delta * timeScale (BuildingComp.java:1922-1929); 0.0 when not healing. The APPLICATION (target.heal writing into another unit frame) defers.

healed.rule: Whether this tick healed (RepairTurret.java:205-207): true exactly when the target is non-null, efficiency > 0, and the angleDist between the target angle and the rotation is under 30 degrees; drives the strength lerp target (RepairTurret.java:212).

source_repair_turret_update_tile_advance.rule: Source-backed RepairTurret updateTile advance from RepairTurret.java / BuildingComp.java / Units.java / HealthComp.java / Block.java / Tile.java / Blocks.java / Mathf.java / Angles.java / Position.java.

frame.rule: The placed-building frame (RepairTower.java:51-54, the build fields): carries refresh / warmup / total_progress / targets plus the folded efficiency / potential_efficiency the advance reads and the heal_suppressed input; missing keys fold to the Java field defaults (0.0 / [] / false), with refresh bound deterministically to 0.0 instead of the Java random init.

heal_amount.rule: The per-def heal amount (unit-repair-tower 1.5f, Blocks.java:6580; class default 1f, RepairTower.java:24): each damaged target heals by healAmount * edelta() per tick.

circle_speed.java_expr: public float circleSpeed = 120f, circleStroke = 3f, squareRad = 3f, squareSpinScl = 0.8f, glowMag = 0.5f, glowScl = 8f;
circle_speed.rule: The class circle speed (120f, RepairTower.java:23, not overridden by the def): totalProgress advances by Time.delta / circleSpeed per tick.

time_delta.rule: Time.delta in ticks (BuildingComp.java:1922-1924, the delta() the heal amount scales by timeScale through edelta(); the refresh / totalProgress advances and the warmup lerp use this value unscaled, Arc Mathf.java:430-432): seconds * TICK_RATE 60 from the placed-block helper.

time_scale.rule: The live building timeScale (BuildingComp.java:98, default 1f): read from the sprite meta; scales the heal amount only, never the refresh / lerp / totalProgress.

supplied_damaged.rule: The damaged list the deferred live scan would return (RepairTower.java:62-66, Units.nearby admitting only damaged units): at refresh the targets clear and refill from this list; the tick supplies the frame targets, since no live scan fills them yet.

source_repair_tower_update_tile_advance_.rule: Source-backed RepairTower updateTile advance from RepairTower.java / BuildingComp.java / Blocks.java / Arc Mathf.java.

refresh.rule: The refresh timer after one tick (RepairTower.java:59-61): advances by the unscaled Time.delta only while potentialEfficiency > 0 (the && short-circuits), and resets to 0f when it reaches refreshInterval 6f.

warmup.rule: The warmup after one tick (RepairTower.java:69-72, 84): 0f when suppressed (the early return), else lerped toward the folded efficiency when any target healed, else toward 0f, at 0.08f by the unscaled Time.delta.

total_progress.rule: The total progress after one tick (RepairTower.java:85): advances by the unscaled Time.delta / circleSpeed 120f; does not advance on the suppressed early return.

targets.rule: The targets after one tick (RepairTower.java:60-66): cleared and refilled from the supplied damaged list when the refresh interval is reached, otherwise unchanged; the live scan that would fill the list is deferred.

heal_amounts.rule: The per-target heal amounts for this tick (RepairTower.java:75-81): healAmount * efficiency * Time.delta * timeScale per damaged target, in target order; a pure result -- applying the heal to live units is deferred.

source_repair_tower_update_tile_advance_.rule: Source-backed RepairTower updateTile advance from RepairTower.java / BuildingComp.java / Blocks.java / Arc Mathf.java.

frame.rule: The building frame carrying the folded efficiency / optional_efficiency (stamped by apply_update_consumption_state), the build fields (warmup / total_time / optional_timer / did_regen / any_targets / last_change / targets / mend_map) and the frame inputs (heal_suppressed, tile_changes).

source_delta.rule: Time.delta in ticks (seconds * 60 through game_source_delta, arc Time.java:26): the UNSCALED delta the warmup approachDelta and the totalTime advance scale by (RegenProjector.java:129-130 use Time.delta, not delta()).

time_scale.rule: The live timeScale read from the sprite meta (SourcePlacedBlockState.time_scale), default 1.0 (BuildingComp.java:98); scales delta() and therefore edelta() (BuildingComp.java:1922-1929).

source_regen_projector_update_tile_advan.rule: Source-backed RegenProjector updateTile advance from RegenProjector.java / BuildingComp.java / Blocks.java / Block.java / World.java.

last_change.rule: The refreshed lastChange (RegenProjector.java:123-125): tile_changes when it differed, unchanged otherwise; the updateTargets() call itself defers (no live building query in the port), so targets stay the frame input.

warmup.rule: The advanced warmup (RegenProjector.java:129): approachDelta toward (didRegen ? 1 : 0) at 1f/70f, using the PREVIOUS tick didRegen (Java line order: warmup advances before the didRegen reset).

total_time.rule: The advanced total time (RegenProjector.java:130): totalTime += NEW warmup * UNSCALED Time.delta (Java line order: warmup is assigned before the totalTime line).

optional_timer.rule: The advanced optional timer (RegenProjector.java:142-144): optionalTimer += edelta() * optionalEfficiency, reset to 0f at the 480f threshold; the consume() call at the threshold defers (no items on the frame), the reset models the cadence.

did_regen.rule: Whether this tick regenerated (RegenProjector.java:131/153): reset false, then true when any damaged, non-heal-suppressed target accumulated a mend amount.

any_targets.rule: Whether any supplied target is damaged (RegenProjector.java:132/139): reset false, then the contains-damaged fold over the frame targets list; false on suppressed ticks (the early return precedes the fold).

mend_map.java_expr: mendMap.put(pos, Math.min(Math.max(value, healAmount * edelta() * build.block.health / 100f), build.block.health - build.health));
mend_map.rule: The accumulated mend map (RegenProjector.java:157-158): per-target-pos mend amount, Math.max (no stacking) capped by the missing health; the flush (RegenProjector.java:168-177) defers, so the map is per-building, not the Java static shared map.

heal_amount.java_expr: float healAmount = Mathf.lerp(1f, optionalMultiplier, optionalEfficiency) * healPercent;
heal_amount.rule: The heal amount for this tick (RegenProjector.java:147): lerp(1, optionalMultiplier 2f, optionalEfficiency) * healPercent (4f/60f, the regen-projector def, Blocks.java:2019); 0.0 when the heal branch does not run (suppressed or efficiency <= 0).

consumed.rule: Whether this tick crossed the optionalUseTime threshold (RegenProjector.java:142-144): true exactly when consume() would fire and optionalTimer resets; the item removal itself defers.

last_update_frame.rule: The stamped frame id after this tick (RegenProjector.java:168-170): update_id when the flush fired (last_update_frame != update_id on entry), unchanged otherwise -- including on a suppressed tick, which returns before the flush block. The frame input defaults to -1 (`private static long lastUpdateFrame = -1;`, RegenProjector.java:24) against the update_id default 0 (`public long updateId;`, GameState.java:23, incremented once per logic update, Logic.java:512), so a fresh frame flushes once and then waits for a live updateId source.

heal_applications.rule: The flushed mend amounts as a pure result {pos: amount} (RegenProjector.java:168-177): the whole mend_map when the flush fired, empty otherwise -- including on a suppressed tick and when the frame id is unchanged. Java applies each entry to the live building (world.build(pos) + build.heal + recentlyHealed(), the timestamp write `lastHealTime = Time.time;`, BuildingComp.java:491-493); the port reports the map and applies nothing -- the live application waits for its own slice.

source_regen_projector_update_tile_advan.rule: Source-backed RegenProjector updateTile advance from RegenProjector.java / BuildingComp.java / Blocks.java / Block.java / World.java.

frame.rule: The building frame carrying the folded efficiency (stamped by apply_update_consumption_state), the current target / rotation / reloadCounter / team_id; Java field defaults target null (PointDefenseTurret.java:59), rotation 90 (BaseTurret.java:114), reloadCounter 0.0 (ReloadTurret.java:26), efficiency 0.0 (BuildingComp.java:85).

source_delta.rule: Time.delta in ticks (seconds * 60 through game_source_delta, arc Time.java:26): the delta edelta() multiplies (BuildingComp.java:1927-1929) for the rotation moveToward speed, the reloadCounter charge, and the cooling charge.

time_scale.rule: The live timeScale read from the sprite meta (SourcePlacedBlockState.time_scale), default 1.0 (BuildingComp.java:98): delta() = Time.delta * timeScale (BuildingComp.java:1922-1924).

turret_range.rule: The def range from the driver constant (180f for the segment, Blocks.java:3838): the retarget rect half-size (PointDefenseTurret.java:66) and the look-at within range (PointDefenseTurret.java:78).

bullet_damage.rule: The def bulletDamage from the driver constant (30f for the segment, Blocks.java:3843; class default 10f, PointDefenseTurret.java:33): the realDamage factor (PointDefenseTurret.java:87).

reload.rule: The def reload from the driver constant (8f for the segment, Blocks.java:3844; PointDefenseTurret ctor 30f, PointDefenseTurret.java:40; ReloadTurret class default 10f, ReloadTurret.java:9): the fire threshold (PointDefenseTurret.java:85) and the canReload bound (ReloadTurret.java:51).

building_x.rule: The building world x: Building x is tile.drawx() (BuildingComp.java:124), drawx is block.offset + tile.worldx() (Tile.java:175-176) with offset ((size + 1) % 2) * tilesize / 2f (Block.java:761) -- 4 for the size-2 segment; the retarget rect center and the angle origin (PointDefenseTurret.java:66/:79).

building_y.rule: The building world y: Building y is tile.drawy() (BuildingComp.java:124), drawy is block.offset + tile.worldy() (Tile.java:179-180); the retarget rect center and the angle origin (PointDefenseTurret.java:66/:79).

bullets.java_expr: target = Groups.bullet.intersect(x - range, y - range, range*2, range*2).min(b -> b.team != team && b.type().hittable, b -> b.dst2(this));
bullets.rule: The explicit retarget candidate list -- the stand-in for the Groups.bullet.intersect rect result (EntityGroup.java:207, QuadTree hitbox overlap): each a target dict with x / y / team / hittable. The pure selection applies the min filter (enemy team + hittable) and the raw-dst2 min with Seq.min last-wins ties (Seq.java:329). The driver always passes an empty list -- no live bullet query.

retarget_tick.rule: Whether the retarget timer fired this tick (retargetTime 5f, PointDefenseTurret.java:21): true models a timer tick and overwrites the frame target exactly like Java's unconditional assignment (PointDefenseTurret.java:66), even to null when no candidate qualifies; false means the timer did not fire and the target is untouched. The TIMER CADENCE itself defers (no timer helper in the port, the N2193 precedent), so the driver always passes false.

block_damage_multiplier.rule: The blockDamage(team) multiplier (Rules.java:299-301): state.rules.blockDamageMultiplier * the team rule, both default 1f (Rules.java:113/:367), so the default is 1.0; the realDamage factor (PointDefenseTurret.java:87).

coolant_present.rule: Whether the block has a coolant consumer (BaseTurret.init :50-51 findConsumer): false for the segment (the def has no ConsumeCoolant consumer), so the updateCooling branch never runs live; true models a def that has one.

coolant_amount.rule: The coolant.amount of the ConsumeCoolant consumer: the cooling charge factor (ReloadTurret.java:32-34). 0.0 when no coolant is present.

coolant_efficiency.rule: The coolant.efficiency(this) of the ConsumeCoolant consumer: the updateCooling gate requires it > 0 (ReloadTurret.java:29) and it factors the charge amount (ReloadTurret.java:32). 0.0 when no coolant is present.

heat_capacity.java_expr: float capacity = coolant instanceof ConsumeLiquidFilter filter ? filter.getConsumed(this).heatCapacity : (coolant.consumes(liquids.current()) ? liquids.current().heatCapacity : 0.4f);
heat_capacity.rule: The resolved heat capacity for the cooling charge (ReloadTurret.java:31): the filter consumed liquid heatCapacity, the current liquid heatCapacity when the coolant consumes it, else the 0.4f fallback (the default).

source_point_defense_turret_update_tile_.rule: Source-backed PointDefenseTurret updateTile advance from PointDefenseTurret.java / ReloadTurret.java / BaseTurret.java / Blocks.java / BuildingComp.java / EntityComp.java / EntityGroup.java / GroupDefs.java / BulletType.java / BulletComp.java / Rules.java / Team.java / Block.java / Tile.java / Position.java / Angles.java / Seq.java / QuadTree.java.

target.java_expr: target = Groups.bullet.intersect(x - range, y - range, range*2, range*2).min(b -> b.team != team && b.type().hittable, b -> b.dst2(this));
target.rule: The target after one tick (PointDefenseTurret.java:65-72): the retargeted closest hittable enemy bullet when the timer fired (null when no candidate qualifies -- Java assigns unconditionally), the kept target otherwise, null when the bullet is pooled (added false). The shot does NOT clear it (Java keeps the field set after target.remove(); the pooled clear nulls it next tick).

rotation.rule: The rotation after one tick (PointDefenseTurret.java:81): moveToward the target angle at rotateSpeed 20f * edelta() (Angles.java:38-39, snap when the angleDist is under the speed); unchanged when the look-at guard fails (no target / out of the strict within range / same team / null type / unhittable) or efficiency is 0.

reload_counter.rule: The reloadCounter after one tick (PointDefenseTurret.java:74-82 + 101): the cooling charge first (updateCooling, ReloadTurret.java:28-41, when coolant is present and canReload and efficiency > 0), then += edelta() while looking at a target, reset to 0 when the shot fires.

target_damage_remaining.rule: The bullet damage remaining after this tick's shot as a pure result (PointDefenseTurret.java:88-89): damage - realDamage when the bullet damage exceeds realDamage (bulletDamage * blockDamageMultiplier); null when no shot fired or the bullet was removed. The APPLICATION (target.damage writing into a live bullet frame) defers.

target_removed.rule: Whether this tick's shot removed the bullet as a pure result (PointDefenseTurret.java:88-91): true exactly when the shot fired and the bullet damage did not exceed realDamage (the boundary is strict: damage == realDamage removes). The APPLICATION (target.remove() on the live bullet) defers.

fired.rule: Whether this tick fired (PointDefenseTurret.java:85-86): true exactly when the look-at guard passed, the rotation is within the 5-degree shootCone of the target angle after the moveToward, and the reloadCounter reached the 8f reload; drives the reloadCounter reset (PointDefenseTurret.java:101).

source_point_defense_turret_update_tile_.rule: Source-backed PointDefenseTurret updateTile advance from PointDefenseTurret.java / ReloadTurret.java / BaseTurret.java / Blocks.java / BuildingComp.java / EntityComp.java / EntityGroup.java / GroupDefs.java / BulletType.java / BulletComp.java / Rules.java / Team.java / Block.java / Tile.java / Position.java / Angles.java / Seq.java / QuadTree.java.

frame.rule: The building frame carrying the folded efficiency (stamped by apply_update_consumption_state), the current target / activation_timer / coolant_multiplier / rotation / strength / last_x / last_y / any; Java field defaults target null (TractorBeamTurret.java:72), activationTimer 0 (BaseTurret.java:115), coolantMultiplier 1f (TractorBeamTurret.java:75), rotation 90 (BaseTurret.java:114), strength / lastX / lastY 0.0 (TractorBeamTurret.java:73), any false (TractorBeamTurret.java:74), efficiency 0.0 (BuildingComp.java:85).

source_delta.rule: Time.delta in ticks (seconds * 60 through game_source_delta, arc Time.java:26): the delta the Arc lerpDelta formula scales by (Mathf.java:430-432), the activation decrement (TractorBeamTurret.java:80), the coolant maxUsed * Time.delta cap (TractorBeamTurret.java:97), and edelta() multiplies (BuildingComp.java:1927-1929).

time_scale.rule: The live timeScale read from the sprite meta (SourcePlacedBlockState.time_scale), default 1.0 (BuildingComp.java:98): delta() = Time.delta * timeScale (BuildingComp.java:1922-1924) and the damage amount is damage * eff * timeScale * blockDamage (TractorBeamTurret.java:125).

building_x.rule: The building world x: Building x is tile.drawx() (BuildingComp.java:124), drawx is block.offset + tile.worldx() (Tile.java:175-176) with offset ((size + 1) % 2) * tilesize / 2f (Block.java:761) -- 4 for the size-2 parallax; the angle origin (TractorBeamTurret.java:116), the retarget center (TractorBeamTurret.java:88) and the impulse origin (TractorBeamTurret.java:132).

building_y.rule: The building world y: Building y is tile.drawy() (BuildingComp.java:124), drawy is block.offset + tile.worldy() (Tile.java:179-180); the angle origin (TractorBeamTurret.java:116), the retarget center (TractorBeamTurret.java:88) and the impulse origin (TractorBeamTurret.java:132).

team_id.rule: The building team id: derelict (0, Team.java:33) retargets to null (Units.java:297), and the look-at guard requires target.team() != team (TractorBeamTurret.java:111).

candidates.java_expr: target = Units.closestEnemy(team, x, y, range, u -> u.checkTarget(targetAir, targetGround));
candidates.rule: The explicit retarget candidate list (each a target dict with team / dead / targetable / in_fog / x / y / hit_size / target_priority / flying / grounded): the stand-in for the Units.closestEnemy rect scan (Units.java:296-313). The list IS the nearbyEnemies result by contract (enemy-only, so there is no same-team check in closestEnemy). The driver always passes an empty list -- no live unit query.

retarget_tick.rule: Whether the retarget timer fired this tick (timer(timerTarget, retargetTime), TractorBeamTurret.java:87, retargetTime 5f, TractorBeamTurret.java:21). False leaves the target untouched even with candidates; true overwrites it with the closestEnemy selection exactly like Java's unconditional assignment (TractorBeamTurret.java:88) -- to null when no candidate qualifies. The TIMER CADENCE itself defers (no timer helper in the port, the N2193 precedent), so the driver passes false.

coolant_present.rule: Whether the coolant consumer exists (coolant != null, TractorBeamTurret.java:92). False for parallax (the def, Blocks.java:3640-3653, has no ConsumeCoolant consumer, so BaseTurret.init :50-51 finds none); the driver passes false.

coolant_amount.rule: The coolant consumer amount (maxUsed, TractorBeamTurret.java:93): the per-tick use cap maxUsed * Time.delta (TractorBeamTurret.java:97). The driver passes 0.0 (no coolant).

liquid_amount.java_expr: float used = Math.min(Math.min(liquids.get(liquid), maxUsed * Time.delta), Math.max(0, (1f / coolantMultiplier) / liquid.heatCapacity));
liquid_amount.rule: The held amount of the current liquid (liquids.get(liquid), TractorBeamTurret.java:97): the first cap on used. The driver passes 0.0 (no coolant, no liquids store on the frame).

liquid_heat_capacity.rule: The current liquid heatCapacity (TractorBeamTurret.java:97/:105): the second cap on used ((1f / coolantMultiplier) / heatCapacity) and the multiplier gain. The driver passes 0.0 (no coolant).

block_damage_multiplier.rule: The rules block-damage multiplier (state.rules.blockDamage(team) = blockDamageMultiplier * teams.get(team).blockDamageMultiplier, Rules.java:299-301; both default 1f, Rules.java:113/:367). The driver passes 1.0 (no rules helper reads it in the port).

status_present.rule: Whether the block status differs from none (TractorBeamTurret.java:128). False for parallax (status is none, TractorBeamTurret.java:31; statusDuration 300, TractorBeamTurret.java:32); the driver passes false.

source_tractor_beam_turret_update_tile_a.rule: Source-backed TractorBeamTurret updateTile advance from TractorBeamTurret.java / BaseTurret.java / Units.java / UnitComp.java / UnitType.java / BuildingComp.java / TimerComp.java / Block.java / Tile.java / Blocks.java / Rules.java / Team.java / Mathf.java / Angles.java / Position.java / Vec2.java / Time.java.

target.java_expr: target = Units.closestEnemy(team, x, y, range, u -> u.checkTarget(targetAir, targetGround));
target.rule: The target after one tick (TractorBeamTurret.java:87-90): the closestEnemy selection when retarget_tick is true (null when no candidate qualifies, derelict team, or an empty list), otherwise the kept frame target; unchanged on the activation early return (TractorBeamTurret.java:79-82).

activation_timer.rule: The activation timer after one tick (TractorBeamTurret.java:79-82): decremented by Time.delta when above 0 (no clamp -- it can go negative, and the next tick proceeds), unchanged otherwise. activationTime is 0f (BaseTurret.java:27), so it never fires for parallax, but the branch is modeled.

coolant_multiplier.rule: The build coolant multiplier after one tick (TractorBeamTurret.java:105): 1f + used * heatCapacity * multiplier when the coolant branch runs (target non-null and coolant present); unchanged otherwise. The formula itself yields 1f when used is 0 -- there is no separate reset anywhere in core/src (grep).

coolant_used.rule: The coolant amount removed this tick as a pure result (TractorBeamTurret.java:99): min(min(held, maxUsed * Time.delta), max(0, (1f / coolantMultiplier) / heatCapacity)); 0.0 when the coolant branch does not run. The frame carries no liquids store, so nothing is written back live.

rotation.rule: The rotation after one tick (TractorBeamTurret.java:117): moveToward toward the target angle at rotateSpeed * edelta (rotateSpeed 12 for parallax, Blocks.java:3651; edelta = efficiency * coolantMultiplier * Time.delta * timeScale, TractorBeamTurret.java:84); unchanged when the look-at guard fails or on the activation early return.

strength.rule: The strength after one tick: lerpDelta toward 1f at 0.1f when the look-at guard holds (TractorBeamTurret.java:120), toward 0f at 0.1f otherwise (TractorBeamTurret.java:135); unchanged on the activation early return. lerpDelta multiplies the progress by Time.delta once more (Mathf.java:430-432).

last_target_position.rule: The last target position after one tick (TractorBeamTurret.java:118-119, lastX = target.x; lastY = target.y;): the target position when the look-at guard holds, unchanged otherwise. Stored as {"x", "y"}.

damage_dealt.rule: The damage dealt this tick as a pure result (TractorBeamTurret.java:125): damage * eff * timeScale * blockDamage(team) with damage 0.5f for parallax (Blocks.java:3649) and eff = efficiency * coolantMultiplier (the INCOMING multiplier, computed at :84 before the coolant branch); 0.0 when not shooting. The APPLICATION (damageContinuousPierce writing into another unit) defers.

status_applied.rule: Whether the status was applied this tick as a pure result (TractorBeamTurret.java:128-130): true exactly when shooting and status_present is true; always false for parallax (status is none). The APPLICATION (target.apply writing into another unit) defers.

impulse.rule: The impulse vector this tick as a pure result (TractorBeamTurret.java:132): (building - target), i.e. FROM the target TOWARD the building, limited to (force + (1f - dst / range) * scaledForce) * edelta with force 16f / scaledForce 9f / range 300f for parallax; Vec2.limit clamps the length to AT MOST the limit (Vec2.java:274-285), it does not set it. Stored as {"x", "y"}; (0, 0) when not shooting. The APPLICATION (impulseNet writing into another unit) defers.

any.rule: Whether the beam shot this tick (TractorBeamTurret.java:108/:131): false at the any reset, true exactly when the look-at guard holds and the rotation is within the shoot cone; unchanged (the previous frame value) on the activation early return, which returns before the reset.

source_tractor_beam_turret_update_tile_a.rule: Source-backed TractorBeamTurret updateTile advance from TractorBeamTurret.java / BaseTurret.java / Units.java / UnitComp.java / UnitType.java / BuildingComp.java / TimerComp.java / Block.java / Tile.java / Blocks.java / Rules.java / Team.java / Mathf.java / Angles.java / Position.java / Vec2.java / Time.java.

frame.rule: The building frame carrying the folded efficiency (stamped by apply_update_consumption_state), the stamped power_status (N2162, default 1.0 when unstamped), and the current exporting / pay_vector / pay_rotation / items / liquids / payload; missing keys default to the Java field defaults (exporting false, payVector (0, 0), payRotation 0f, items / liquids empty, payload null).

source_delta.rule: Time.delta in ticks (seconds * 60 through game_source_delta, arc Time.java:26): the base of delta() = Time.delta * timeScale (BuildingComp.java:1922-1924) and therefore of edelta() = efficiency * delta() (BuildingComp.java:1927-1929).

time_scale.rule: The live timeScale read from the sprite meta (SourcePlacedBlockState.time_scale), default 1.0 (BuildingComp.java:98): delta() = Time.delta * timeScale (BuildingComp.java:1922-1924).

load_tick.rule: Whether the load timer fired this tick (PayloadLoader.java:157): the timer cadence defers (no timer helper in the port), so the pure advance takes it as an explicit bool and the driver passes false.

rotdeg_value.rule: The building rotation in degrees (BuildingComp.java:582-584, rotdeg() = rotation * 90): the moveIn rotation target (PayloadLoader rotates, PayloadLoader.java:45) and the moveOut dest angle (PayloadBlock.java:203).

block_rotate.rule: Whether the block rotates (PayloadLoader.java:45, rotate = true): the moveIn target is rotdeg() when true, 90f otherwise (PayloadBlock.java:192).

item_order.rule: The item names in content-id order (the catalog item_names_by_id): the order the load loop scans (PayloadLoader.java:161-162, content.item(i)), the N2225 precedent.

liquid_names_by_id.rule: The liquid names in content-id order: resolves the loader LiquidModule current id to the name the payload build-liquids dict is keyed by (PayloadLoader.java:182-183).

front.rule: The front-building snapshot gathered by the driver (present / solid / outputs_payload / accepts_payload): canDump = front == null || !front.tile.solid() and canMove = front != null && (front.block.outputsPayload || front.block.acceptsPayload) (PayloadBlock.java:210-211); the driver passes no-front defaults (no live front query yet).

move_payload_result.rule: Whether movePayload succeeded (BuildingComp.java:819-829, needs the live front build): the driver passes false (no live move); the reused helper clears the payload only when this is true at arrival.

base_power_use.rule: The base power use 2f (PayloadLoader.java:79, consPower.usage from the def consumePower(2f), Blocks.java:6686): powerInput = power.status * (basePowerUse + maxPowerConsumption), availableInput = max(powerInput - basePowerUse, 0) (PayloadLoader.java:202-204).

source_payload_loader_update_tile_advanc.rule: Source-backed PayloadLoader updateTile advance from PayloadLoader.java / PayloadBlock.java / BuildingComp.java / Blocks.java / Block.java / ItemModule.java / LiquidModule.java / StorageBlock.java / LiquidRouter.java / LiquidVoid.java / Vars.java.

should_export.rule: Whether the payload should export this tick (PayloadLoader.java:227-233): payload != null && (exporting || liquids-full || separate-items-full || battery-full), evaluated on the tick-start state before moveIn/moveOut.

has_arrived.rule: Whether moveInPayload returned true (PayloadBlock.java:196): payVector.isZero(0.01f), i.e. len2 < 0.01 (arc Vec2.java:679-681); false when there is no payload or shouldExport took the moveOut branch.

exporting.rule: The advanced exporting flag (PayloadLoader.java:87): set when an item load is rejected with separateItemCapacity / consumesItem, when no item was accepted on a load tick, when a liquid load is rejected, or when the battery fills.

pay_vector.rule: The advanced payVector {x, y} (PayloadBlock.java:194/207): approached toward Vec2.ZERO by payloadSpeed * delta() on moveIn, toward the front dest on moveOut (via the reused helper).

pay_rotation.java_expr: payRotation = Angles.moveToward(payRotation, block.rotate ? rotdeg() : 90f, payloadRotateSpeed * delta());
pay_rotation.rule: The advanced payRotation (PayloadBlock.java:192/206): moved toward rotdeg() (PayloadLoader rotates) by payloadRotateSpeed * delta() on both branches.

items.rule: The loader items after the load loop (PayloadLoader.java:166): one unit removed per accepted item, up to itemsLoaded (8) per load tick, scanned in content-id order.

liquids.rule: The loader LiquidModule dict after the liquid load (PayloadLoader.java:192): the flow removed through the shared module helper (which caps the removal at the held amount, LiquidModule.java:126-128), mutated in place like the Fracker advance.

payload.rule: The payload dict after the tick (PayloadBlock.java:147/221): the updated build items/liquids/power_status, or null when moveOut handed it to the front build (movePayload success at arrival).

payload_moved.rule: Whether moveOut handed the payload to the front build this tick (PayloadBlock.java:220-222): arrived && canMove && movePayload succeeded; the payload clears.

payload_dumped.rule: Whether moveOut dumped the payload this tick (PayloadBlock.java:223): arrived && !canMove && canDump; the payload stays present (dumpPayload clears only when payload.dump() succeeds, PayloadBlock.java:230-241, and the port has no live dump).

liquid_flow.java_expr: float flow = Math.min(Math.min(liquidsLoaded * edelta(), payload.block().liquidCapacity - payload.build.liquids.get(liq)), total);
liquid_flow.rule: The liquid flow this tick (PayloadLoader.java:187): min(min(liquidsLoaded * edelta(), payload liquidCapacity - payload held), loader total); 0 when the liquid branch did not run or the payload rejected.

power_charged.rule: The battery status gained this tick (PayloadLoader.java:208): availableInput / cap * edelta(), where availableInput = max(power.status * (basePowerUse + maxPowerConsumption) - basePowerUse, 0); 0 when there is no battery.

items_loaded.rule: How many items moved into the payload this tick (PayloadLoader.java:165, handleItem adds 1, BuildingComp.java:860-862): 0 when the load tick did not fire or nothing was accepted.

pushed_output_fraction.rule: The pushOutput progress fraction this tick (PayloadBlock.java:214): 1 - (payVector.dst(dest) / (size * tilesize / 2f)) when canDump && !canMove, null otherwise (the unit push itself defers -- no live units).

source_payload_loader_update_tile_advanc.rule: Source-backed PayloadLoader updateTile advance from PayloadLoader.java / PayloadBlock.java / BuildingComp.java / Blocks.java / Block.java / ItemModule.java / LiquidModule.java / StorageBlock.java / LiquidRouter.java / LiquidVoid.java / Vars.java.

frame.rule: The building frame carrying the live payload key (PayloadBlock.java:92, `public @Nullable T payload;`, default null) plus pay_vector / pay_rotation / rotation / items / liquids / efficiency / last_output_power. No live fill sets the payload yet; the advance reads the frame as-is.

source_delta.rule: Time.delta in ticks (seconds * 60 through game_source_delta, arc Time.java:26); delta() = Time.delta * timeScale (BuildingComp.java:1922-1924) drives moveIn/moveOut, edelta() = efficiency * delta() (BuildingComp.java:1927-1929) drives the liquid flow and the battery unload.

time_scale.rule: The building timeScale (BuildingComp.java:98, `private transient float timeScale = 1f, timeScaleDuration;`), read live from the sprite meta; scales delta() and edelta().

load_tick.rule: Whether the load timer fired this tick (PayloadUnloader.java:69). The timer cadence defers (no timer helper in the port), so the driver passes false; the pure advance still ports the full tick logic and the efficiency > 0.01f guard.

item_order.rule: The content-id item order (the catalog item_names_by_id, the N2225 precedent): Java scans items.length() by content id (PayloadUnloader.java:72-74), so the port scans this order and unloads the first item the payload holds.

front.rule: The explicit front-building flags for moveOutPayload (PayloadBlock.java:209-211): present / solid / outputs_payload / accepts_payload / move_payload_result. No live neighbor query exists, so the driver passes front-absent.

source_payload_unloader_update_tile_adva.rule: Source-backed PayloadUnloader updateTile advance from PayloadUnloader.java / PayloadLoader.java / PayloadBlock.java / BuildingComp.java / Blocks.java / LiquidModule.java / ItemModule.java / Vars.java / Vec2.java.

payload.rule: The held payload after the tick (PayloadUnloader.java:59/61): null when the instant-deconstruct clear fired or moveOutPayload moved it into the front building; otherwise the (possibly unloaded) payload dict. The payload dict contract is defined in the driver: block flags + build items / liquids module state / power_status.

pay_vector.rule: The payload offset after the tick (PayloadBlock.java:194/207): approached toward the center by moveInPayload or toward the front dest by moveOutPayload, at payloadSpeed * delta() per tick (PayloadBlock.java:18, 0.7f). Stored as {x, y}.

pay_rotation.java_expr: payRotation = Angles.moveToward(payRotation, block.rotate ? rotdeg() : 90f, payloadRotateSpeed * delta());
pay_rotation.rule: The payload rotation after the tick (PayloadBlock.java:192/206): moved toward rotdeg() (block.rotate is true for PayloadLoader, PayloadLoader.java:45) at payloadRotateSpeed * delta() per tick (PayloadBlock.java:18, 5f).

items.rule: The own items after the unload (PayloadUnloader.java:76): up to itemsLoaded (8) items per timer tick, taken from the payload build in content-id order while !full() (PayloadUnloader.java:112-114, items.total() >= itemCapacity 100). Keyed by item name (the factory precedent).

liquids.rule: The own liquids module state after the unload (PayloadUnloader.java:89): the payload current liquid added by flow = min(min(liquidsLoaded * edelta(), remaining), payload amount) (PayloadUnloader.java:87), in the SourceLiquidModuleState shape (amounts array by liquid id + current id).

last_output_power.rule: The battery power unloaded this tick (PayloadUnloader.java:98): min(maxPowerUnload * edelta(), payload power status * cap), 0f when the tick unloads no battery (reset at PayloadUnloader.java:54). This IS the power production (getPowerProduction returns it, PayloadUnloader.java:44-47); the graph wiring waits for its own slice.

should_export.rule: The shouldExport gate (PayloadUnloader.java:116-122): payload != null and the payload items empty (or no items) and the payload liquids <= 0.011f (or no liquids) and the payload battery status <= 0.0000001f (or no battery). True means the tick exports instead of unloading.

moved_in.rule: Whether moveInPayload arrived this tick (PayloadBlock.java:240-243): payVector.isZero(0.01f), i.e. len2() < 0.01 (the Arc quirk, Vec2.java:679-681, NOT margin squared). Only an arrived payload unloads.

payload_moved.rule: Whether moveOutPayload moved the payload into the front building this tick (PayloadBlock.java:220-222): arrived at the dest with canMove and the movePayload result true, so the payload cleared. The movePayload application itself defers; the helper reports the outcome.

payload_dumped.rule: Whether moveOutPayload called dumpPayload this tick (PayloadBlock.java:223-225): arrived at the dest with canDump and no canMove. The dump application defers (payload.dump() needs a live payload), so the payload stays on the frame.

deconstructed.rule: Whether the instant-deconstruct branch fired this tick (PayloadUnloader.java:57-59): shouldExport with a payload block whose instantDeconstruct flag is set. The breakEffect presentation defers; the payload = null clear IS modeled.

items_unloaded.rule: How many items left the payload build this tick (PayloadUnloader.java:75): 0 when the timer did not fire, efficiency <= 0.01f, the payload holds no listed item, or the own items are full.

liquids_unloaded.java_expr: float flow = Math.min(Math.min(liquidsLoaded * edelta(), remaining), payload.build.liquids.currentAmount());
liquids_unloaded.rule: How much liquid left the payload build this tick (PayloadUnloader.java:87-90): the flow folded from liquidsLoaded * edelta(), the remaining own capacity, and the payload current amount; 0.0 when the guard fails (payload amount < 0.01f, or a mismatched current with own amount > 0.2f).

source_payload_unloader_update_tile_adva.rule: Source-backed PayloadUnloader updateTile advance from PayloadUnloader.java / PayloadLoader.java / PayloadBlock.java / BuildingComp.java / Blocks.java / LiquidModule.java / ItemModule.java / Vars.java / Vec2.java.

frame.rule: The building frame carrying the folded efficiency (stamped by apply_update_consumption_state) and the current deconstructing / payload / accum / progress / time / speed_scl / items / pay_vector / pay_rotation; missing keys default to the Java field defaults (PayloadDeconstructor.java:52-55, PayloadBlock.java:92-95).

source_delta.rule: Time.delta in ticks (seconds * 60 through game_source_delta, arc Time.java:26): the delta the edelta() / lerpDelta formulas scale by; lerpDelta uses Time.delta unscaled (Mathf.java:430-432).

time_scale.rule: The live timeScale read from the sprite meta (SourcePlacedBlockState.time_scale), default 1.0 (BuildingComp.java:98): delta() = Time.delta * timeScale (BuildingComp.java:1922-1924).

deconstruct_speed.rule: The def deconstructSpeed (PayloadDeconstructor.java:19): 6f for the deconstructor (Blocks.java:6655), 3f for the small-deconstructor (Blocks.java:6646), 2.5f class default; the shift numerator. The catalog parses no deconstructSpeed property, so the driver reads per-def constants.

item_capacity.rule: The capacity the canProgress gate and the transfer / rounding checks compare against (PayloadDeconstructor.java:132, 172, 184): the catalog itemCapacity -- 250 for the deconstructor (Blocks.java:6652), 100 for the small-deconstructor (Blocks.java:6643) and the ctor default (PayloadDeconstructor.java:37).

build_cost_multiplier.rule: state.rules.buildCostMultiplier (Rules.java:115, default 1f): the accum multiplier for a BuildPayload deconstructing (PayloadDeconstructor.java:164). The driver reads it from the rules dict with the Java default when the port rules shape does not carry it yet.

unit_cost_multiplier.rule: state.rules.unitCost(team) (Rules.java:275-276): the accum multiplier for a UnitPayload deconstructing (PayloadDeconstructor.java:164); the global and per-team multipliers both default to 1f (Rules.java:83/361). The driver reads it live through SourceRulesRuntimeState.source_unit_cost_state.

source_payload_deconstructor_update_tile.rule: Source-backed PayloadDeconstructor updateTile advance from PayloadDeconstructor.java / PayloadBlock.java / BuildPayload.java / UnitPayload.java / Rules.java / BuildingComp.java / Block.java / Blocks.java / arc Mathf.java / Angles.java / Vec2.java.

progress.rule: The advanced progress (PayloadDeconstructor.java:117-119, 159, 201): 0f with no deconstructing payload, + shift (NOT realShift, so it can pass 1f) while deconstructing, 0f again when the intake starts a new payload.

time.rule: The advanced deconstruction time (PayloadDeconstructor.java:160): + edelta() on every tick the deconstruct branch can progress.

speed_scl.rule: The advanced speed scale (PayloadDeconstructor.java:167): lerpDelta toward 1f while canProgress, toward 0f otherwise, at 0.1f scaled by Time.delta.

accum.java_expr: accum[i] += reqs[i].amount * (deconstructing instanceof BuildPayload ? state.rules.buildCostMultiplier : state.rules.unitCost(team)) * realShift;
accum.rule: The accumulation buffer after the tick (PayloadDeconstructor.java:126-128, 163-165, 170-176, 182-189, 194, 198): resized to the requirements length, folded by amount * cost multiplier * realShift, drained by whole-item transfers and the rounding check, null on finish or fresh zeros on intake.

items.rule: The items after the tick (PayloadDeconstructor.java:170-176, 184-187): whole taken amounts transferred from accum, plus 1 per requirement that hits the rounding check at finish.

deconstructing.rule: The payload being deconstructed after the tick (PayloadDeconstructor.java:193, 199): null when the finish branch clears it, the intake payload when moveInPayload succeeds, unchanged otherwise.

payload.rule: The held payload after the tick (PayloadDeconstructor.java:200): null once the intake moves it into deconstructing, unchanged otherwise (no live fill sets it yet).

pay_vector.rule: The payload offset after the tick (PayloadBlock.java:194): approached toward zero at payloadSpeed * delta() by the moveInPayload intake (deconstructor payloadSpeed 1f, PayloadDeconstructor.java:31); unchanged while deconstructing.

pay_rotation.rule: The payload rotation after the tick (PayloadDeconstructor.java:121): moved toward 90f at payloadRotateSpeed (5f, PayloadBlock.java:18) * edelta() -- NOTE edelta(), not delta() as in moveInPayload.

finished.rule: Whether a deconstruction finished this tick (PayloadDeconstructor.java:179-195): progress reached 1f and the rounding check passed, so deconstructing / accum were cleared.

read_unit_id.rule: The readUnitId after this tick (UnitCargoLoader.java:98-103): -1 whenever it was not -1 coming in (the single-player port always takes the !net.client() branch, so the id clears even when found_unit is null), unchanged (-1) otherwise.

warmup.rule: The advanced warmup (UnitCargoLoader.java:105): approachDelta toward the folded efficiency at 1f/60f, using the UNSCALED source_delta.

readyness.rule: The advanced readyness (UnitCargoLoader.java:106): approachDelta toward (unit != null ? 1 : 0) at 1f/60f, using the POST-clear / POST-unbox unit (Java line order: the lost check and the unbox precede the fold).

build_progress.rule: The advanced build progress (UnitCargoLoader.java:109/129): buildProgress += edelta() / unitBuildTime (480f) while no unit is held and canCreate passes, reset to 0f on spawn via spawned() (UnitCargoLoader.java:127-133, server branch); frozen otherwise.

total_progress.rule: The advanced total progress (UnitCargoLoader.java:110): totalProgress += edelta() while no unit is held and canCreate passes; frozen otherwise (it never resets -- only buildProgress resets on spawn).

spawned_unit.rule: The unit spawned this tick (UnitCargoLoader.java:112-122, the pure result, the N2228 consumed precedent): {type: manifold, x, y, rotation: 90, dead: false, added: true} when buildProgress reached 1f, else null; the live creation/application (unitType.create + BuildingTetherc building(this) + unit.set/add + the remote call + Fx.spawn) defers.

consumed.rule: Whether consume() fired this tick as a pure result (ForceProjector.java:212-214): phaseValid && !broken && consume_tick && efficiency > 0. The APPLICATION (consume() taking the phaseFabric item) defers -- the frame has no items.

cooldown.rule: The advanced cooldown (StackConveyor.java:273/311): reeled by speed * eff * delta() with RAW delta, clamped to [0, recharge]; set to recharge on transfer. The reel runs before the link gate, so it reels even with link == -1 or when disabled.

link.rule: The advanced link (StackConveyor.java:309/342): -1 after a transfer (the stack moved to the front) or after poofOut drains the last item; unchanged otherwise.

last_item.rule: The advanced last item (StackConveyor.java:282-284/297): picked as items.first() in content-id order when null or no longer held; null after the unload branch drains it (poofOut). The pick runs before the !enabled return, so a disabled conveyor still picks.

items.rule: The self items after the advance (StackConveyor.java:291-293/310): drained one by one in the unload loop (items.remove(lastItem, 1) per iteration), cleared wholesale on transfer (items.clear()).

unloaded.rule: The count unloaded in the unload branch (StackConveyor.java:290-300): one per successful moveForward/dump iteration until lastItem runs out (poofOut) or the neighbour stops accepting.

transferred.rule: Whether the transfer fired this tick (StackConveyor.java:301-314): state != stateLoad || total >= getMaximumAccepted, front is a same-team StackConveyorBuild with link == -1; cooldown = recharge marks the fired transfer.

front_items.rule: The front items after the transfer (StackConveyor.java:304; ItemModule.add(ItemModule), ItemModule.java:228-232): the whole self stack added with NO capacity cap in Java, so the pure caps nothing.

front_last_item.rule: The front last item after the transfer (StackConveyor.java:305): the transferred lastItem.

front_link.rule: The front link after the transfer (StackConveyor.java:306): this tile packed position.

front_cooldown.rule: The front cooldown after the transfer (StackConveyor.java:312): 1 (the front build starts reeling the received stack).

source_stack_conveyor_update_tile_advanc.rule: Source-backed StackConveyor updateTile advance from StackConveyor.java / BuildingComp.java / Blocks.java / ItemModule.java / Block.java.

frame.rule: The building frame carrying the folded efficiency (stamped by apply_update_consumption_state), enabled, and the advance state unloading / current / progress / items; Java field defaults unloading false (StackRouter.java:25), current null + progress 0.0 (DuctRouter.java:79-80), efficiency 0.0 (BuildingComp.java:85), enabled true (BuildingComp.java:77), items empty.

speed.rule: The def speed from the driver constant (6f for the surge-router, Blocks.java:2259; class default 5f, DuctRouter.java:19): the charge cap, `float cap = speed;` (StackRouter.java:30).

base_efficiency.rule: The def baseEfficiency from the driver constant (1f for the surge-router, Blocks.java:2265; class default 0f, StackRouter.java:12): the eff floor, `float eff = enabled ? (efficiency + baseEfficiency) : 0f;` (StackRouter.java:29).

item_capacity.rule: The def itemCapacity from the driver constant (10, StackRouter.java:20, also the Block default, Block.java:75): the charge gate, `items.total() >= itemCapacity` (StackRouter.java:32).

targets.rule: The explicit ordered handoff-target list (each entry a dict with an "id"): the stand-in for the DuctRouter.target() live proximity query (DuctRouter.java:139-156). Each entry models one target() call result, popped in order per handoff (cdump rotation simulated by list order); the driver always passes an empty list -- no live proximity query -- so no live handoff happens.

item_order.rule: The catalog item order (item_names_by_id, the content-id order ItemModule.first() scans, ItemModule.java:182-189): the first() scan order for the current pick (StackRouter.java:62-63). Empty means no content order is known and nothing is picked.

source_stack_router_update_tile_advance_.rule: Source-backed StackRouter updateTile advance from StackRouter.java / DuctRouter.java / ItemModule.java / BuildingComp.java / Block.java / Blocks.java.

unloading.rule: Whether the router is unloading after one tick (StackRouter.java:38-40 + 56-58 + 66-68): true when the charge reached the cap, false when the current item ran dry or the store emptied.

current.rule: The current item after one tick (StackRouter.java:57 + 62-63 + 68): null when the current item ran dry or the store emptied, otherwise the kept item or the first held item in content-id order.

progress.rule: The progress after one tick (StackRouter.java:33-40): charged by eff (no delta multiply) while full with a current item, wrapped by progress %= cap on reaching the cap, untouched otherwise.

items.rule: The items after one tick (StackRouter.java:48-52): one unit of the current item removed per handoff (clamped like ItemModule.remove, ItemModule.java:258-262); zero-count keys stay in the dict, so callers read counts, never key presence.

handed_off.rule: How many items were handed off this tick as a pure result (StackRouter.java:48-52): one per targets entry consumed while the current count stayed above zero. The APPLICATION (target.handleItem writing into another building frame) defers.

handed_to.rule: The handoff target ids in handoff order as a pure result (StackRouter.java:47 + 52): one id per handoff, following the explicit targets list order (the cdump-rotation stand-in).

time_scale.rule: The building live timeScale (BuildingComp.java:98), read through timeScale() (BuildingComp.java:599-601): the lerp target; the port reads it from the sprite time-scale meta, default 1.0.
