launch_counter.rule: The launchCounter value the gate read (LaunchPadBuild.launchCounter, LaunchPad.java:84): advanced by edelta each tick (the counter half of LaunchPad.java:146), frozen at launchTime while the gate is closed because edelta() is then 0.

source_launch_pad_should_consume_state_r.rule: Source-backed LaunchPad shouldConsume gate from LaunchPad.java / BuildingComp.java.

frame.rule: The building frame carrying the live reload_counter (ShockwaveTower.java:67, `public float reloadCounter = Mathf.random(reload);`): the counter the gate reads; a fresh frame starts at 0.0, which preserves the gate outcome at spawn because Mathf.random(reload) is always < reload.

block.rule: The catalog block (shockwave-tower def, reload 80f, Blocks.java:2043): the reload the gate compares against; the class default 60f * 1.5f (ShockwaveTower.java:26) is the fallback when the block carries no reload.

source_shockwave_tower_should_consume_st.rule: Source-backed ShockwaveTower shouldConsume gate from ShockwaveTower.java / BuildingComp.java / Blocks.java.

should_consume.rule: The shouldConsume gate (ShockwaveTower.java:121-122): true while the reload counter is below reload; when false, updateConsumption forces efficiency to zero (BuildingComp.java:1960 + 1992-1994).

reload_counter.rule: The frame reload counter the gate read (ShockwaveTower.java:67): advanced each tick by the updateTile charge (ShockwaveTower.java:73, `(reloadCounter += edelta())`).

source_shockwave_tower_should_consume_st.rule: Source-backed ShockwaveTower shouldConsume gate from ShockwaveTower.java / BuildingComp.java / Blocks.java.

frame.rule: The radar building frame carrying the updateTile state (Radar.java:49-52): smooth_efficiency (default 1f, `public float smoothEfficiency = 1f;`), progress (default 0f), total_progress (default 0f) and last_radius (default 0f, `public float lastRadius = 0f;`). The advance reads the pre-tick values and returns the post-tick ones.

efficiency.rule: The folded efficiency (Radar.java:61): the lerp target for smoothEfficiency and the multiplier of the total-progress advance (Radar.java:71). In the driver this is the frame efficiency folded by the N2173 consumption pass, 1.0 before the first fold (BuildingComp.java:1965, "assume efficiency is 1").

edelta.rule: Efficiency * delta (BuildingComp.java:1927-1929): the progress advance numerator (Radar.java:68, `progress += edelta() / discoveryTime;`) and the total-progress factor (Radar.java:71). The driver passes efficiency * source_delta with timeScale 1f (BuildingComp.java:98, the default).

source_delta.rule: Time.delta in 60fps ticks (arc Time.java:26 scales the frame delta by 60f): the lerpDelta progress scale (arc Mathf.java:430-432). The driver passes seconds * TICK_RATE (the N2093 pump precedent).

fog_radius.rule: The block fogRadius (Blocks.java:1991): the fogRadius() base (Radar.java:56, `return fogRadius * progress * smoothEfficiency;`). The catalog carries no fogRadius property, so the driver passes the single-def constant 34.0.

discovery_time.rule: The discovery time (Radar.java:18, 60f * 10f = 600f): the progress advance divisor (Radar.java:68). A full-efficiency radar discovers in 600 ticks.

source_radar_update_tile_input.rule: Source-backed Radar updateTile advance from Radar.java / BuildingComp.java / arc Mathf.java.

advance.rule: The post-tick frame state (Radar.java:60-72): {"smooth_efficiency": lerped toward efficiency, "progress": advanced by edelta() / discoveryTime and clamped to [0, 1], "total_progress": accumulated by efficiency * edelta(), "last_radius": fogRadius() when the radius changed by >= 0.5f, else unchanged}. The driver writes it back onto the frame.

force_update_needed.rule: Whether the fog radius changed by >= 0.5f this tick (Radar.java:63): true exactly when Java calls Vars.fogControl.forceUpdate(team, this) (Radar.java:64). The port tracks the condition + the lastRadius write; the fog-system call itself waits for its own fog slice.

seconds.rule: The driver tick length in seconds -- the port Time.delta (the conduit precedent): the lerpDelta/slerpDelta scale and the time/progress advance step.

launch_heat.rule: Launch heat after one tick (Accelerator.java:140): lerpDelta toward 1f when launching, toward 0f otherwise, at 0.1.

progress.rule: Progress after one tick (Accelerator.java:142-145): advanced by Time.delta * efficiency / buildDuration (120f) when efficiency >= 0f, clamped at 1f.

source_accelerator_update_tile_advance_s.rule: Source-backed Accelerator updateTile advance from Accelerator.java / Mathf.java.

time_scale.rule: The sprite-meta timeScale (BuildingComp.java:599-600, `return timeScale;`, default 1f, BuildingComp.java:98): scales the warmup lerp toward 1 (warmupSpeed * timeScale, ImpactReactor.java:82).

total_progress.rule: The advanced totalProgress (ImpactReactor.java:98): the previous total plus the new warmup times Time.delta.

production_efficiency.rule: The production efficiency (ImpactReactor.java:100): pow(warmup, 5f) from the advanced warmup; tracked as a frame key here -- the producer fold (PowerGenerator.java:156-158) does not read it yet and waits for its own slice.

reload_value.rule: The per-def reload (mender 200f, mend-projector 250f, Blocks.java:1923/1936): the charge threshold the scan branch compares against; read through the family helper (SourceMendProjectorState.projector_reload).

heal_percent.rule: The per-def healPercent (mender 4f, mend-projector 11f, Blocks.java:1925/1938; class 12f, MendProjector.java:28): the base percent of maxHealth each heal restores.

phase_boost.rule: The per-def phaseBoost (mender 4f, mend-projector 15f, Blocks.java:1926/1939; class 12f, MendProjector.java:29): the extra heal percent per unit of phaseHeat.

phase_range_boost.rule: The per-def phaseRangeBoost (mender 20f, mend-projector class 50f -- not overridden in Blocks.java:1932-1941; class 50f, MendProjector.java:30): the extra range per unit of phaseHeat.

time_delta.rule: Time.delta in ticks (BuildingComp.java:1922-1924, the delta() the charge recompute scales by timeScale): seconds * TICK_RATE 60 from the placed-block helper.

time_scale.rule: The live building timeScale (BuildingComp.java:98, default 1f): read from the sprite meta; scales the charge recompute only.

can_heal.rule: Whether the projector may heal (MendProjector.java:94): the documented default true, since the tick tracks no suppression state (the N2184 BuildTurret suppression precedent); false blocks the scan branch.

source_mend_projector_heal_scan_input.rule: Source-backed MendProjector heal scan from MendProjector.java / BuildingComp.java / HealthComp.java / Blocks.java.

real_range.rule: The scan radius for this tick (MendProjector.java:107): the per-def range plus the post-advance phaseHeat times the per-def phaseRangeBoost; computed whether or not the branch runs.

heal_amounts.rule: The heal amounts in candidate order (MendProjector.java:113): one entry per eligible candidate (damaged and not heal-suppressed), each maxHealth * (healPercent + phaseHeat * phaseBoost) / 100f * efficiency; empty when the branch does not run or no candidate is eligible. The caller applies the amounts; recentlyHealed() / Fx / sound stay deferred.

any.rule: Whether any candidate was healed (MendProjector.java:35, 110, 116): the Java `any` field, set true once per healed target; the tick records it on the frame inside last_heal_scan, and the deferred mendSound gates on it.

scanned.rule: Whether the heal branch ran this tick (MendProjector.java:106): the recomputed crossing (charge_before + heat_after * time_delta * time_scale >= reload) while canHeal holds; false below reload or when suppressed.

source_mend_projector_heal_scan_result.rule: Source-backed MendProjector heal scan from MendProjector.java / BuildingComp.java / HealthComp.java / Blocks.java.

source_delta.rule: Time.delta in ticks (seconds * 60 through game_source_delta, arc Time.java:26), UNSCALED: lerpDelta scales progress by Time.delta, not by delta() (arc Mathf.java:430-432).

unit_look_angle.rule: The lookAt angle (BuildTurret.java:128-130): the explicit build_plan_angle while actively building, else the unit rotation unchanged -- the unit facing next tick, since this tick rotation already read the pre-lookAt value.

potential_efficiency.rule: The potential efficiency after the suppression zeroing (BuildTurret.java:132-134): 0.0 when suppressed, else the folded potential (defaulting to efficiency, BuildingComp.java:1989, the N2227 precedent).

speed_multiplier.rule: The speed multiplier (BuildTurret.java:137): post-suppression potentialEfficiency * timeScale.

source_build_turret_update_tile_advance_.rule: Source-backed BuildTurret updateTile advance (sync + warmup) from BuildTurret.java / BaseTurret.java / BuildingComp.java / Blocks.java / Block.java.

frame.rule: The building frame carrying the builder unit plan queue (frame["plans"], default [] -- the unit plan queue, `public BlockUnitc unit = (BlockUnitc)unitType.create(team);`, BuildTurret.java:93, mirrored as an Array of plan dicts), the followed unit (frame["following"], default null -- `public @Nullable Unit following;`, BuildTurret.java:94, a dict with id / valid / actively_building / first_plan, or null), and the last picked team plan (frame["last_plan"], default null -- `public @Nullable BlockPlan lastPlan;`, BuildTurret.java:95, a BlockPlan dict with a removed flag, or null).

controlled.rule: Whether the tower is player-controlled (ControlBlock.isControlled): true takes the controlled branch (`}else{ //is being controlled, forget everything`, BuildTurret.java:217-220, following = lastPlan = null); false runs the autonomous plan logic. The driver passes false -- no live player control exists in the port.

search_ready.rule: The search timer tick (`timer(timerTarget, targetInterval)`, targetInterval 15, BuildTurret.java:29): true lets an empty queue search the team plans (BuildTurret.java:156). The port has no timer infra, so this is an explicit input; the driver passes false.

break_check_ready.rule: The break-plan re-check timer tick (`timer.get(timerTarget2, 30f)`, BuildTurret.java:193): true lets the validation branch scan team players for a conflicting break plan. The port has no timer infra, so this is an explicit input; the driver passes false.

tower_x.rule: The tower world x in pixels (the building getX() Java measures within() from): the search and mimic range checks compare team-plan / builder-build world positions against this. The driver passes the origin cell x * tilesize (tilesize 8, Vars.java:135; size-3 offset 0, Block.java:217).

tower_y.rule: The tower world y in pixels (the building getY()): the search and mimic range checks compare team-plan / builder-build world positions against this. The driver passes the origin cell y * tilesize.

range_value.rule: The tower range in pixels (200f for the single build-tower def, Blocks.java:2001): the within radius for the plan search and the mimic scan. within is the strict squared-distance check (`Mathf.dst2(getX(), getY(), x, y) < dst*dst`, Arc Position.java:44-46).

team_plans.rule: The explicit team plan queue (`team.data().plans`, BuildTurret.java:157): each entry a BlockPlan dict {x, y, rotation, block, config, valid_place, removed} where valid_place is the explicit Build.validPlace + resources predicate the port cannot evaluate (BuildTurret.java:163). The driver passes an empty list -- no live team-plan list exists in the port.

nearby_builders.rule: The explicit nearby builders list (the Units.nearby scan stand-in, BuildTurret.java:176-187): each entry a dict {id, can_build, actively_building, first_plan, build_is_construct, build_x, build_y} where build_is_construct mirrors `build instanceof ConstructBuild` and build_x/build_y is the build world position for the within check. The driver passes an empty list -- no live unit query exists in the port.

players.rule: The explicit team players list (`team.data().players`, BuildTurret.java:195): each entry a dict {is_builder, actively_building, plan} where plan is {x, y, breaking} for the samePos + breaking check (BuildPlan.samePos is x/y equality, BuildPlan.java:83-85). The driver passes an empty list -- no live player list exists in the port.

req_construct_match.rule: Whether the current request tile holds a ConstructBuild whose current block equals the requested block (BuildTurret.java:206): the first disjunct of the validity gate. The port has no tile lookup, so this is an explicit input; the driver passes false.

req_valid_place_or_break.rule: Whether the current request still places (or breaks, when breaking) -- the Build.validBreak / Build.validPlace disjunct of the validity gate (BuildTurret.java:207-210). The port cannot evaluate the Build API, so this is an explicit input; the driver passes true, assuming the current request stays valid.

pay_length.rule: The advanced payLength (PayloadMassDriver.java:220): unloaded by payloadSpeed * delta() when idle/accepting with a loaded payload; NOT clamped at 0 -- it may go negative for one tick (Java only flips loaded).

pay_rotation.rule: The advanced payRotation (PayloadMassDriver.java:224 / PayloadBlock.java:206): moved toward turretRotation + 180f when the unload finishes, toward rotdeg during the moveOut approach.

heat.rule: The heat after one tick (ShockwaveTower.java:82/:104): set to 1f when the wave fires, then the unconditional decay subtracts Time.delta / reload * cooldownMultiplier and clamps to [0, 1] (Arc single-arg clamp, Mathf.java:402-404) -- so a fired tick ends below 1f and every tick decays.

targets.rule: The target list after one tick (ShockwaveTower.java:74-77/:89-94): the scanned enemy hittable bullets when the gate passed (each with its post-wave damage and a removed flag -- damage strictly above waveDamage loses waveDamage, the rest are removed), the previous list when the gate failed (Java only clears inside the gate). The APPLICATION (target.damage writing / target.remove() on live bullets) defers.

wave_damage.rule: The wave damage this tick (ShockwaveTower.java:87): min(bulletDamage, bulletDamage * falloffCount / targets.size) when the wave fires, 0.0 otherwise.
